title: Weather diary sheet
subject: Arabic
source: Written for arabic/y9 lesson 16 (Weather diary sheet (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 16: Bridge: weather and the future with سَـ and سَوْفَ. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

head: Arabic
English
rows: it is rainy / it is raining

head: Present
Future
rows: سَأَذْهَبُ / سَوْفَ أَذْهَبُ: I will go

panels.title: Tomorrow's weather
points: Tomorrow the weather will be cold
After سَيَكُونُ the adjective ends in -an

model.title: If it is sunny, I will go to the park.

parts.text: إِذَا (if) + كَانَ (was, used for 'is' after if)

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: إِذَا كَانَ الجَوُّ مُشْمِسًا سَأَذْهَبُ إِلَى الحَدِيقَةِ، إِنْ شَاءَ اللّٰهُ.

questions.a: سَأَلْعَبُ فِي الحَدِيقَةِ / سَوْفَ أَلْعَبُ فِي الحَدِيقَةِ.

questions.q: Core: Write a forecast for three days (اليَوْم، غَدًا، بَعْدَ غَدٍ) and one plan for each day.
questions.a: For example: اليَوْمَ الجَوُّ بَارِدٌ، سَأَقْرَأُ فِي البَيْتِ. غَدًا سَيَكُونُ الجَوُّ مُشْمِسًا، سَأَذْهَبُ إِلَى الحَدِيقَةِ. بَعْدَ غَدٍ سَتُمْطِرُ، سَوْفَ أَزُورُ جَدَّتِي.

questions.q: Extend: Add إِنْ شَاءَ اللّٰهُ to each plan and one sentence with إِذَا.
questions.a: For example: إِذَا كَانَ الجَوُّ مُمْطِرًا سَأَبْقَى فِي البَيْتِ، إِنْ شَاءَ اللّٰهُ.

questions.q: Stretch: Compare the weather in Britain and Saudi Arabia in January in two sentences.
questions.a: For example: فِي بِرِيطَانِيَا الجَوُّ بَارِدٌ فِي يَنَايِر، لٰكِنَّهُ أَدْفَأُ فِي السُّعُودِيَّةِ.
C) سَأَقْرَأُ. سَـ + present verb = future.

questions.q: What does غَدًا mean? A) tomorrow B) today C) yesterday
Big question: say tomorrow's weather and one plan in Arabic.
questions.a: For example: سَيَكُونُ الجَوُّ مُشْمِسًا غَدًا، وَسَأَزُورُ جَدِّي، إِنْ شَاءَ اللّٰهُ.
